svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.23.13.8 Foundation Cripple Walls
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.23 WOOD-FRAME CONSTRUCTION
Foundation Cripple Walls

g.text: Smax 0.60 or less: wood-sheathed as the
Smax over 0.60: 350 mm high or less,
CRIPPLE WALLS THAT NEED NOT COMPLY WITH SENTENCE (1)
(i) framed with solid blocking, or (ii) of the same construction as the
braced wall panels of the storey above but sheathed with wood sheathing,
Not heavyweight construction, masonry or stone veneer, (2)(d)
Otherwise: considered as an additional storey, or designed to Part 4, (1).
As printed: the heading reads “See Note A-9.23.13.8.)” and Clause (3)(c) reads “not more than 5 m length,”.

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
Except as provided in Sentences (2) and (3), foundation
cripple walls supporting braced wall panels are
(a) considered as an additional storey, or (b) designed in
accordance with Part 4.
Where the seismic design parameter, Smax, is less than or
equal to 0.60, foundation cripple walls need not comply with
Sentence (1), provided they
(a) are not more than 1.2 m in height, (b) are not more than 6 m
in length, (c) are either (i) framed with solid blocking, or
(ii) of the same construction as the braced wall panels of the
storey above but sheathed with wood sheathing regardless of the
construction, where the length of the cripple wall bracing is
equal to the length of the braced wall panels multiplied by an
adjustment factor of 1.2, in addition to any adjustments
required by Sentences 9.23.13.7.(1) and (2), and (d) do not
support heavyweight construction, masonry or stone veneer. (See
Where the seismic design parameter, Smax, is greater than
0.60, foundation cripple walls need not comply with Sentence
(1), provided they
(a) comply with Clauses (2)(c) and (d), (b) are not more than
350 mm in height, and (c) are not more than 5 m length. (See
Where interior finish, such as gypsum board, is omitted from
the interior side of the cripple wall referred to in
Sentence (2) or (3), the interior gypsum board adjustment
factor described in Sentence 9.23.13.7.(3) or (4) is applied
to the length of the cripple wall bracing.
Drawn: cripple walls in yellow on a foundation wall, sheathing cut back to show the studs. Option (ii) of Clause (2)(c) shown. Sizes are illustration only.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.23.13.8. (page 9-212)
